description: Measurement records of the experiments that the eight-stage runner does not produce. Each set is a directory records/<set>/ holding summary.csv (one measured value per row, each traced to the raw file it is read from), the raw logs under raw/, the code and configurations under code/, and provenance.json. scripts/records.py checks every value against its raw file and prints the supplementary table from the summary.

baselines.title: Per-rerun resource ledger and retrained baselines

quantities.wall_time: controller-branch wall time in nominal executions (nominal = 1)
quantities.gpu_hours: qualification or retraining GPU-hours from the scheduler accounting
quantities.score: official test metric of one optimization seed (percent or AP points)
quantities.hpo_trials: hyperparameter trials under the shared 48-trial ceiling

baselines.notes: Exported by scripts/export_records.py baselines from the pinned-upstream studies of scripts/run_upstream_baseline.py, the E17 timing rows (cm_campaigns.timing) and the original sacct exports. Rows without a seed carry per-method quantities; the score SD over the optimization seeds is computed from the per-seed rows.

quantities.official_metric: official test metric (percent or F1 points)

quantities.residual_activity: fraction of graphs or episodes with residual action activity
quantities.input_fallback: fraction of graphs or episodes returned by the input fallback

input_gate.title: Serving-time input gate and deployed latency

quantities.fallback_probability: fraction of test inputs returned to q_C by the input gate g_input
quantities.deployed_wall_overhead_percent: deployed latency after fallback relative to q_C (percent)

nominal_time.title: Per-input nominal execution time
nominal_time.notes: Exported by scripts/export_records.py from-runs (wall seconds of one nominal member execution per input, from the run's own execution record) or from E17 timing rows; provenance.json states which.

sensor_parameters.title: Executed sensor parameters

quantities.sketch_dim: executed sketch width k (0 = full-state sensing)

sensor_parameters.notes: The runtime separates spectral sensing_period from observer_period. Sealed config values and observed action counts are exported; trace counters record actual acquisitions. Manuscript observer period must not substitute for a missing sensing period.

quantities.route_stable_folds: outer folds selecting the reported route

ensemble_grid.title: Ensemble law on the extended grid

quantities.loss_nats: comparator loss of the E-member ensemble with the paired seed structure (nats)

ensemble_grid.notes: The table fits l(E) = l_inf + D_inf / E by least squares over the deposited ensemble sizes, as Supplementary Table S26b states.

budget_matched.title: Budget-matched arms at the common ceiling

quantities.effect_vs_qc_nats: mean paired loss of the arm minus q_C on the independent comparison units D_compare (nats)
quantities.effect_vs_feedback_nats: mean paired loss of the arm minus the confirmed feedback rule q_M (nats); positive favours q_M
quantities.effect_vs_feedback_ci_low_nats: lower end of the 95% crossed seed-by-unit bootstrap interval of the arm-minus-q_M effect (nats)
quantities.p_holm: Holm-adjusted two-sided paired sign-flip P value within the dataset's family of four arms
quantities.work_ratio: expected deployed work of the arm relative to q_C on the independent comparison inputs D_compare
quantities.ceiling: registered common ceiling (expected work relative to q_C)

budget_matched.notes: Exported by scripts/export_records.py budget-matched from a complete campaign export (scripts/arm_campaign.py export --complete). Every value is read from the campaign's analysis.json, which cm_campaigns.arm_campaign.check_campaign recomputes from the paired per-unit observations and the input-level work ledgers. The configuration key is 'selected': each controller replicate's development-selected configuration.
